selected.primary_estimand: Within-subject change in whole-blood expression after cardiopulmonary exercise (2 maximal CPET ~24 h apart; day 1 baseline vs days 2, 3, 7) in ME/CFS and in sedentary controls, and whether that change differs between the groups.
planned_contrasts: Day 1 vs Day 2 / Day 3 / Day 7 within CFS and within HC (TAB3 lower block; paper 0 each)
Pre vs post in ME/CFS as compared to controls, overall (days 1,2 vs days 3,7) or at any single time point (S3.3.p2; paper 0)
ME/CFS vs controls at day 1, 2, 3, 7 (TAB3; paper 0,0,0,1) and all days (TAB3; paper 6; associational, not an exercise effect)
Low VO2 ME/CFS subset and test-retest subset vs regular repeat exercise by day (TAB3; subject labels not deposited)
selected.design_timing: Blood drawn within 2 h BEFORE each CPET on day 1 and day 2, then at home on day 3 and day 7 (S2.5.p1). Day 1 is the only unexercised sample; there is no acute post-exercise sample.
selected.inclusion: 14 female ME/CFS, 11 matched sedentary controls (S3.1.p1); day 3 and day 7 samples of one subject removed for <40% expressed genes (S3.3.p1); subjects who completed only one CPET retained (S3.2.p2)

paper_threshold.literal_text: fold change > +/-1.5, p-value < 0.05, and adjusted p-value (or FDR) < 0.1% (S2.5.1.p1)
paper_threshold.interpretation: Methods print 'FDR < 0.1%' but every all-days DEG in TAB4 has FDR 0.02-0.10; the rule that generated the reported lists is FDR < 0.1 (10%). The literal 0.001 rule is carried as the audit rule.

selected.paper_method: Partek Flow 5.0 multimodel (normal, lognormal, lognormal with shrinkage, negative binomial, Poisson; per-gene best AICc) on STAR/Cufflinks hg38 RefSeq FPKM (S2.5.1.p1)
selected.paper_results: 0 DEGs before vs after exercise in either group; 6 ME/CFS vs control all days, 1 at day 7; 19 unique overall, 15 considered likely false positives (S3.3.p2, S4.p2)

decisions.reason: Study map from S2.2, S2.4, S2.5, S2.5.1, S3.3 and TAB3/TAB4.

checks: 14 ME/CFS + 11 control subjects as in S3.1.p1
matrix file named in GEO description field

decisions.reason: Paper data statement names the series. 99 of the paper's 100 libraries (S2.5.p1) are deposited: Sample_G12-7 is absent. The GEO processing note (hg19, TopHat2/Bowtie2, Cufflinks) differs from the paper (hg38, STAR, Cufflinks), recorded as a discrepancy.

excluded_samples.GSM3664608: Sample_P14-3: day 3 of the one subject removed by the paper for <40% expressed genes (S3.3.p1)
excluded_samples.GSM3664609: Sample_P14-7: day 7 of the same subject (S3.3.p1)

decisions.reason: Exact match of matrix columns to metadata title (99/99). Subject, disease and day are explicit GEO fields. cfs_d2/d3/d7 are 0/1 indicators of ME/CFS at that day so the disease-by-time terms can be written full rank next to the subject block. P14-3/P14-7 identified from detection rates matching S3.3.p1.

selected.source: GSE128078_FES_isoforms_FPKM.txt.gz summed to gene level by scripts/prep_gene_level.py

decisions.reason: Non-integer values up to 4.96e5, file named FPKM, data_processing says FPKM from Cufflinks, paper FN.p1 says FPKM deposited. Not counts, so count methods are out and FPKM is not rounded.

selected.analysis_type: repeated measures, disease by time with subject blocking
selected.estimand_type: within-subject change (uncontrolled pre/post); per-day group comparisons are associational
selected.timing_note: day 1 is pre-exercise; day 2 is ~24 h after CPET 1 and before CPET 2; days 3 and 7 are ~1 and ~5 days after CPET 2 (S2.5.p1, S2.4.p1)

decisions.reason: S2.5.p1: 4 samples per subject. S3.3.p2/TAB3 set the contrasts. Disease is absorbed by the subject block, so the model keeps subject, time, and disease-by-time only.

covariates.name: grp
covariates.disposition: nested: within subject; its between-subject effect is absorbed by the block

covariates.name: library batch
covariates.disposition: excluded: not deposited in GEO; S2.5.p1 and S3.3.p1 report no batch clustering by PCA and randomized processing

covariates.name: age, BMI
covariates.disposition: excluded: matched by design (TAB1) and not deposited; absorbed by the subject block

decisions.reason: Same subject at four days. The per-day group comparisons use independent subjects, one sample each, so they carry no block.

selected.method: limma moderated t on log2(FPKM+1), subject as fixed block

paper_route.method: Partek Flow GSA multimodel with AICc per-gene model selection
paper_route.reason: proprietary software with no executor here, and its count-model arms need counts; only FPKM is deposited

deviations: limma on log2(FPKM+1) replaces Partek GSA
no low-expression filter, as in the paper (S3.3.p2 reports DEGs with coverage below 1)

decisions.reason: Matrix policy: FPKM goes to log2(x+1) then limma. Rounding FPKM to fit a count model is not allowed.

paper_threshold.literal_text: fold change > +/-1.5, p-value < 0.05, and adjusted p-value (or FDR) < 0.1% (S2.5.1.p1)
paper_threshold.interpretation: Methods print 'FDR < 0.1%' but every all-days DEG in TAB4 has FDR 0.02-0.10; the rule that generated the reported lists is FDR < 0.1 (10%). The literal 0.001 rule is carried as the audit rule.

selected.deviation_note: Paper's FDR comes from Partek GSA per-gene best-model p-values; here BH on limma moderated t, within each contrast. The paper's extra p<0.05 clause cannot bind except when almost all genes are significant, and no contrast here comes close.

decisions.reason: S2.5.1.p1 states FC>1.5, p<0.05, FDR<0.1%, yet TAB4 lists DEGs at FDR up to 0.10 and S4.p2 calls them borderline, so 0.1% is read as 0.1 for the applied rule; literal FDR<0.001 + FC 1.5 is the audit rule so both counts are visible.
One limma model on all 97 samples with subject block: day effects within each group, disease-by-time, and the overall days 1,2 vs 3,7 contrast.
